linked_prs.title: feat (docs): add qwen-ai-provider community provider
linked_prs.body:
Hi Vercel AI,

I’d like to propose including my project, [qwen-ai-provider](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qwen-ai-provider), in the Vercel AI documentation. This module provides a unified interface to work with Alibaba cloud Qwen AI. fixes #4596

NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qwen-ai-provider

Github: https://github.com/Younis-Ahmed/qwen-ai-provider

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it requests support for a new LLM provider/model (Alibaba Cloud Qwen), which falls under the "Unsupported models" sub-category of agent issues related to LLM provider integration.
